Highlight linked selections

Source: R/crosstalk.R
highlight.Rd

Sets how a figure responds to, and shows, selections of points linked with crosstalk. A figure is linked when its data come from a crosstalk::SharedData (give one as the data_frame of a px_*() function, pipe one into go_figure() and add traces with formulas such as add_scatter(x = ~col), or link traces with set_crosstalk_keys()): selecting points then selects the rows with the same keys in every view of the same crosstalk group, such as other plots, crosstalk::filter_select() inputs, DT tables or leaflet maps. Linked figures highlight on click by default; highlight() changes that.

Usage

highlight(
  p,
  on = "plotly_click",
  off,
  persistent = getOption("persistent", FALSE),
  dynamic = FALSE,
  color = NULL,
  selectize = FALSE,
  defaultValues = NULL,
  opacityDim = getOption("opacityDim", 0.2),
  selected = attrs_selected(),
  debounce = 0,
  ...
)

attrs_selected(opacity = 1, ...)

Arguments

p

A go_figure() (e.g. from a px_*() function) or a plotly htmlwidget.

on

The event that selects points: "plotly_click", "plotly_hover", "plotly_selected" (box or lasso selection) or "plotly_selecting" (selection while dragging). NULL turns selecting from this plot off.

off

The event that clears the selection: "plotly_doubleclick", "plotly_deselect" or "plotly_relayout". The default matches on: "plotly_deselect" for selections, otherwise "plotly_doubleclick". NULL turns clearing off.

persistent

Whether new selections add to the current one rather than replace it. Holding the shift key while selecting does this too.

dynamic

Whether to show a colour picker for the selection colour.

color

The selection colour (several, for dynamic = TRUE): R colour names, hex colours or CSS colours such as "rgba(255,0,0,0.5)". NULL keeps the points' own colours and dims the rest.

selectize

Whether to show a searchable dropdown of the keys, which selects them; or a list of selectize.js options for it.

defaultValues

Keys selected when the figure is first shown.

opacityDim

Opacity multiplier (0 to 1) of points not selected.

selected

Trace attributes of the selected points, made with attrs_selected().

debounce

Milliseconds to wait before selecting, for frequent events such as "plotly_hover" and "plotly_selecting".

...

Unused.

opacity

Opacity of the selected points.

Value

p with the highlighting options. attrs_selected() returns a list of trace attributes.

Details

The options match the plotly package's highlight(), and highlight() also works on plotly htmlwidgets.

See also

set_crosstalk_keys()

Examples

sd <- crosstalk::SharedData$new(px_data_iris())
px_scatter(sd, x = ~sepal_width, y = ~sepal_length, color = ~species) |>
  highlight(on = "plotly_selected", color = "red")
